verdict.rationale: 2FAS is local-first. Vault data can live in your own cloud or as an encrypted file on an external drive, the pricing page advertises "Freedom to self-host your data", and community reports confirm WebDAV, iCloud and local-file backup targets. The code is published on GitHub (open-source Auth, source-available Pass), but no evidence documents running a self-hosted server deployment of the product itself. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted server or sync-backend deployment, self-hosting setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted setup.
